_meta.source: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Table B.52.4 (PVC insulated copper, two loaded conductors: single-phase and DC) and Table B.52.5 (three loaded conductors: three-phase), 30 C ambient, 1 to 120 mm2 (the 50 to 120 mm2 rows added 2026-10-21 for battery and inverter DC cables, audit WL-170): columns B1 (insulated conductors in conduit on or in a masonry wall; NOT A1, conduit in a thermally insulated wall, which is rated lower) and C (clipped direct). The 1 mm2 row is not in Tables B.52.4/B.52.5 (they start at 1.5 mm2); its values are the same-basis BS 7671 Table 4D1A figures (methods B and C, two and three loaded conductors). Correction factors: Table B.52.14 (ambient air other than 30 C, PVC) and Table B.52.17 row 1 (circuits bunched in air, on a surface, embedded or enclosed). Pakistani n/d sizes converted with formulas.md section W (A = n x pi x (d x 25.4 / 2)^2) and rated as the largest IEC size not above their real area (one rule for every wiring page, conservative).
_meta.status: Engineer to confirm against the IEC tables and Pakistan Cables / Fast Cables datasheets. Every rating is multiplied by the ambient factor (design air temperature, default derating.default_ambient_c, a conservative hot-climate value pending PEC review, editable on the page) and the grouping factor (circuits in one conduit, default 1).
_meta.fields: cables: area_mm2 nominal conductor size; ampacity_a per installation method with two loaded conductors (single-phase, DC); ampacity_3ph_a the same with three loaded conductors (three-phase). pk_sizes: strands, strand diameter in inches, real area, rated_as_mm2 = the largest row of cables whose area is not above the real area (used for its ampacity). derating: ambient_factors and grouping_factors as [value, factor] rows; a value between two rows takes the factor of the next row up (higher temperature, more circuits). breaker_margin_load_types: load types whose MCB is chosen at I_b x margin (continuous motor-type loads), so a 1.5 ton AC gets a 16 A MCB on 2.5 mm2 rather than 10 A on 1 mm2. sold_as_mm2: the metric size the shop sells that n/d cable as (BS imperial to metric equivalence charts; Pakistan Cables price lists name sizes both ways), printed next to the n/d name when it differs from the size we rate it as; set on the rows where the two differ in a way that misleads a buyer (7/52 sold as 10 mm2 but rated 6; 7/64 sold as 16 mm2 but rated 10; the large sizes added 2026-10-21, audit WL-170/180).

methods.B1: In conduit in a brick or plastered (masonry) wall, most Pakistani house wiring; a conduit buried in thermal insulation is method A1 and is rated lower
methods.C: Clipped direct to a wall or surface

mcb_curves._source: IEC 60898-1 instantaneous tripping ranges: B 3-5 x In, C 5-10 x In, D 10-20 x In

B.use: lighting, sockets and resistive loads (heaters, irons, geysers)

C.use: air conditioners, fridges, motors, water pumps and mixed socket circuits

D.use: transformers, welding machines and large motors with heavy inrush

min_area_mm2._source: Lighting 1.0 mm2 copper: BS 7671 Table 52.3 minimum for lighting circuits (IEC 60364-5-52 Table 52.2 sets 1.5 mm2 for power and lighting circuits); other 2.5 mm2 and common Pakistani practice (3/29 for lighting points, 7/29 for sockets and air conditioners); PEC question: is 1.0 mm2 accepted for lighting or is 1.5 mm2 the minimum? Engineer to confirm

derating._source: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Table B.52.14 (PVC, ambient air) and Table B.52.17 row 1 (bunched in air, on a surface, embedded or enclosed)
derating._status: default_ambient_c is a conservative Pakistani summer design value pending PEC engineer review; ratings at 30 C are kept in the table above

pv_cables._source: EN 50618:2014 (H1Z2Z2-K solar cable) Annex A Table A.3: current-carrying capacity at 60 C ambient, 120 C conductor, single core: in free air, on a surface, two cables touching (on a surface); Table A.4 ambient correction factors. Default roof air 70 C: a cable on or under hot panels in a Pakistani summer [ENGINEER]. Added 2026-10-21 for W4 (audit WL-180); house-wiring PVC ratings stay in cables. Below 60 C the factor is kept at 1 (no uprating). isc_factor: a PV string cable must be rated for at least 1.25 × the string's short-circuit current (IEC 62548-1 / IEC 60364-7-712).

methods.surface: Clipped on a roof, frame or tray surface
methods.free_air: In free air, spaced from surfaces
methods.touching: Two cables touching on a surface (positive and negative together)
